effort.note: Grade 5 is reserved for technical terrain. Bands are the half-open ranges [0,6), [6,12), [12,20), [20,30) and 30 or more. The formula is the v1 one with the mode factor of `modes`; walking is 1.

modes.note: Four km of riding count as one km of walking. This factor is our rule, labelled as ours.

rule.house_grade: family_effort = max(terrain grade from the source grade, effort band). The terrain grade comes from the source grade through this file, else from the drivers, else from a reviewer override.
rule.no_local_grade: When the source grade is missing or unmapped, the terrain grade comes from the drivers (terrain_basis drivers). With no drivers either, family_effort equals the effort band and is shown as a hollow badge.
